brief.headline: Priority alert: possible ticket switch on the self checkout camera.
observed: At 0.6 s: Bagging count rose to 1 with no scan in the two seconds before.
At 3.8 s: Scan registered, but the product match was 0.42 and the price was 0.31 of the expected price.
At 5.8 s: Scan registered, but the product match was 0.13 and the price was 0.18 of the expected price.
Weakest product match was 0.13; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0.78 (range 0.45 to 0.87).
Lowest price ratio was 0.18; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0.96 (range 0.43 to 1).
benign_explanations: The product recogniser is wrong about a new or seasonal pack.
The item carries a genuine reduced to clear label.
Loose produce was looked up under a similar product.
brief.recommended_action: Ask the host to verify the line before payment and keep the label for the duty manager.
brief.confidence_note: Model risk is 1.00, which is strong evidence for this scenario. Pose tracking was clear throughout the clip.
